summary: Iteration 87 - Frontend testing for VehicleDetails visit item party dropdown feature. All features tested and working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VehicleDetails visit item party dropdown feature is fully functional. When adding a new item in a visit and changing type to 'supplier' or 'customer', the dropdown correctly shows registered suppliers/customers from the system. Manual entry option ('إدخال يدوي') is available for both types and works correctly.

frontend: ✅ Visit card expands to show items table
✅ 'إضافة بند جديد' (Add New Item) button works
✅ Type dropdown shows 4 options: خدمة (service), قطعة (part), عميل (customer), مورد (supplier)
✅ Changing type to 'supplier' shows party dropdown with 14 registered suppliers
✅ Supplier dropdown includes: الراكضي, الدرويش, القرعاوي, الحصان, الزايدي ليات, العبدالرحيم, مخرطه, الإقبال, دانية, الزايدي, أبو خالد الكبير, ساسكو, مورد اختبار التكرار
✅ Supplier dropdown has 'إدخال يدوي' (Manual Entry) option
✅ Changing type to 'customer' shows party dropdown with 121 registered customers
✅ Customer dropdown includes all registered customers from the system
✅ Customer dropdown has 'إدخال يدوي' (Manual Entry) option
✅ Selecting 'إدخال يدوي' shows manual text input field
✅ Manual input field has correct placeholder: 'اكتب اسم المورد يدويًا' / 'اكتب اسم العميل يدويًا'
✅ Manual entry field accepts text input correctly
✅ Switching between types (service→supplier→customer→service→part→supplier) does NOT cause freezing or breaking
✅ All type transitions are smooth and responsive
